ModMetaData.name: Luminescent Walls
ModMetaData.author: Better Rimworlds
ModMetaData.description: Luminescent stone and metal walls provide gentle powered light. The walls emit a 'sourceless light', largely as described in the book "The Unincorporated Man" by Dani Kollin and Eytan Kollin. Only newly generated Ancient Dangers contain luminescent limestone wall samples; repeatedly deconstruct them to complete the Luminescent Walls project, which cannot be researched normally and unlocks limestone, sandstone, granite, slate, and marble variants. Luminescent Plasteel is a separate, normally researchable project that requires Luminescent Walls and unlocks only plasteel. Existing or already generated dangers are unchanged.
